Common questions

No. CIPHER is permissionless. Connect your wallet, deploy a protocol, go. We don't collect personal data and we never will. The GHOST tier is completely anonymous.
The monthly tiers include a request allocation. Overages are billed at $0.0000012 per request — less than a fraction of a cent. You set a spending cap; we'll never charge beyond it without your explicit authorization.
Yes. We accept ETH, USDC, USDT, and CIPHER tokens. Paying with CIPHER tokens gives you an additional 15% discount. Credit card is also accepted for fiat payments.
GHOST gets Groth16 proofs suitable for simple balance and identity verification. OPERATOR adds PLONK and recursive proofs for complex multi-party computations. SOVEREIGN gets access to our custom circuit compiler for building entirely new cryptographic primitives.
99.99% means <53 minutes of downtime per year. If we miss it, you get service credits automatically — we don't make you file a claim. SOVEREIGN customers also get a dedicated incident response team on standby.
